plugins.//: The root package is a private workspace container, so @semantic-release/npm only bumps its version and never publishes. prepare: lockstep-bump all four package manifests and exact internal dependency edges, then resync the lockfile. publish: build once in DAG order, then publish core before React and adapters, followed by testing. React and adapters are peers in publication order: both depend on core, not on each other. Starter pins and eternal-pose versions are bumped deliberately per plugin release, never here.
plugins.publishCmd: npm run build --workspace @laugh-tale-island/core --ignore-scripts && npm run build --workspace @laugh-tale-island/react --ignore-scripts && npm run build --workspace @laugh-tale-island/adapters --ignore-scripts && npm run build --workspace @laugh-tale-island/testing --ignore-scripts && npm publish -w packages/core --provenance --access public && npm publish -w packages/react --provenance --access public && npm publish -w packages/adapters --provenance --access public && npm publish -w packages/testing --provenance --access public
